answer: A bond of 24% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in harbor, and oasis reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 150 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mesa account. Scaling to 415 identities multiplies that fee by 797 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
